text: After founding the first settlement (tick 2932) the era panel still shows '[ ] Village 0/1'. A player would expect founding a settlement to tick 'Village'. It is not clear what 'Village 0/1' asks for (a settlement of some size? a building?).

Inside the settlement, the greyed-out 'Build House' and 'Build Farm' buttons show no tooltip or cost on hover, so a player cannot tell what a house costs or that houses raise the resident cap (needed for Members 10).

Build House needs a two-click confirm, but at the game's low frame rate (1-2 fps, tps ~10) the confirm window expired before the second click landed four times in a row ('Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.', ticks 3668, 3756, 3840, 3904). Only two clicks fired back-to-back worked (House built, tick 3980). The confirm window seems to be ~60 ticks; it should be longer or wall-clock based.

With a resident nearby, the settlement action buttons (Appoint Trader, Order: Gather Wood, Talk to, Gift...) stack up over the Objective panel, hiding the objective text ('Reach the Village era') behind them.

Inside the settlement, W/A/S/D and pt walkto do nothing (player x/z stayed 16.45/163.07 for ~1400 ticks) and Escape opens the pause menu rather than leaving. The only hint that you are 'inside' is the button row; the 3D view looks like the open world, so it feels like the character is frozen. Expected: Escape or walking to leave the settlement, or a clear 'You are inside X - press E/Exit to leave' banner.

Recruiting is invisible on screen: next to a stranger pawn the button row offers only nation-level actions (Propose Alliance / Gift Lowerham 25 coins / Declare War), with no Invite or Gift-pawn button. Invite (R) and Gift (G) are only on page 1 of the ? Controls screen. Also, the pawn name tag sits behind the Chronicle panel (top middle), so the player can't see who they're chasing.

By day 1 afternoon (tick ~8400) nearly every wandering pawn has declared or founded its own one-person nation (chronicle lists 20+ nations: Lowerham, Villageport, Townshire, Oldton, Blackburg...). Tilly Smith: 'I lead Lowerham. We are 1 strong.' This empties the pool of recruitable strangers just when the Village era needs 10 members; after the 2 auto-joins at founding I gained no members.

Pawns are hard to reach for E/R: pt walkto pawn timed out or got 'stuck: not getting closer' 6 of 8 tries because wandering pawns move about as fast as the walking player at 1-2 fps; when I did reach Tilly Smith, she walked out of the 5-unit reach before the next key press. R then said 'There is no one within reach to invite.' (tick 8432).

Game ran at 1-3 fps and 3-12 tps (target 50) for the whole session. At this rate day 2 (the Day 1/2 Village requirement, ~tick 21000 from the 0.30 start) is ~35 minutes of real time away, so the time gate could not be reached in a 30-minute session. Tick 8576 at timeOfDay 0.586.
